title: Two Seymour vertices in every sink-free oriented graph
subtitle: An exceptional-boundary and aggregate-fiber argument
author: Myeongjin Kang
scope: Every nonempty finite sink-free oriented graph has two distinct vertices whose exact second out-neighborhood cardinality is at least the first.
proof_gate: PASS_FULL_S2 for frozen candidate, internal independent review
contribution_gate: CONTRIBUTION_PASS_SUBSTANTIAL for frozen candidate, bounded literature coverage
